surface.entry: tests/security/upstream-credential-binding.test.ts, driving the production configuration path packages/company/src/configuration.ts (configureCompanyCode) through the real gateway registration path packages/gateway/src/index.ts
surface.host: a synthetic upstream that records every request the connector makes and can answer, refuse, redirect or impersonate; a synthetic reviewed connector configuration and a 0600 token file written into an isolated temporary directory
surface.transport: the real MCP SDK streamable-HTTP client over an injected fetch, so the real handshake, the real request construction and the real error handling are exercised
surface.singleAuthority: No new endpoint, table, capability or authentication mode was added. The project keeps exactly one upstream authentication shape (auth.mode is the literal API_KEY with a 0600 token file) and the oracle proves that shape's binding boundaries against the real configuration code.

behavior.credentialBoundToOneEndpointIdentityAndC: The reviewed credential is bound through hash(canonical({config, credentialHash: hash(token)})) and companyCodeBindingHash(id, connectorId, connectionBinding), so the endpoint, the connector identity and the credential are bound together. A credential issued for another service is refused before any upstream request (connection disabled, no capability registered, zero recorded upstream requests), and the same reviewed credential presented under another connector identity is refused the same way.
behavior.noAlternativeAuthenticationPath: An unreviewed auth mode is rejected outright by configureCompanyCode with zero upstream requests and no capability registration. The project ships no OAuth or JWT adapter, so there is no second credential path and no fallback that could authenticate the request some other way.
behavior.exactlyTheReviewedCredentialIsSent: With the reviewed credential the connector sends 'Bearer <reviewed token>' on every request, and a server whose identity is not the reviewed one fails with COMPANY_CONNECTION_UNAVAILABLE; the requests issued before that failure still carry only the reviewed credential.
behavior.authenticationRefusalIsTerminal: An upstream 401 produces exactly one POST initialize request, no GET, no .well-known, oauth-protected-resource or dynamic client registration request and no second credential. The failure message is COMPANY_CONNECTION_UNAVAILABLE, carries no credential, and no capability is registered.
behavior.redirectNeverCarriesTheCredential: A 302 pointing at another service fails the connection, every recorded request stayed on the reviewed endpoint, and the credential never appeared on a foreign origin.
behavior.oracleIsNotVacuous: A mutation check replaced the binding-hash comparison in packages/company/src/configuration.ts with a constant; the foreign-credential and foreign-identity cases then failed with 'expected false, received true'. The production file was restored byte-for-byte afterwards and git diff confirmed no residual change.
